changes.what: Added an informative evidence-stage non-substitution matrix spanning definition and derivation, computational realization, implementation conformance, projection lock, controlled empirical contact, operational qualification, and outcome/requalification evidence.
changes.why: The existing rules were distributed across the Canon, MFDI, PC-AEP, replay, and requalification materials. A single matrix makes clear that success at one stage cannot silently establish a stronger later-stage claim.

changes.what: Crosschecked frozen evaluation, milestone-claim discipline, projection integrity, replay, falsification, monitoring, execution binding, and outcome requalification against newly supplied external materials while importing no external formula, primitive, taxonomy, verdict system, architecture, or proprietary term.
changes.why: External comparison is useful only when it tests for a genuine missing requirement rather than creating novelty pressure or intellectual-property contamination.
downstream: no canonical gate or component change

changes.what: Advanced only the correction build identifier to 2026.08.10.2, synchronized exact release pins, and made the master verifier fail if the evidence-stage matrix or current crosscheck/report metrics disappear or drift.
changes.why: A modified package requires a distinct reproducible build identity, and informative claim-boundary hardening should be regression-tested like other release surfaces.

rejected_changes: No sixth gate or new score
No import of external ontology, formulas, admissibility semantics, verdict labels, hardware stack, or proprietary terminology
No replacement of rights, tail-risk, structural-viability, SGP, or RLS layers
No empirical, physical-safety, or deployment-readiness claim
claim_boundary: This build strengthens evidence-stage reporting and release integrity. It does not establish evidence truth, construct validity, legal authority, physical safety, framework superiority, or deployment readiness.
